verzen.tekst: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

verzen.tekst: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

verzen.tekst: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

verzen.tekst: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

verzen.tekst: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

verzen.tekst: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
verzen.html: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

verzen.tekst: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

verzen.tekst: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

verzen.tekst: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

verzen.tekst: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

verzen.tekst: There was much murmuring amongst the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

verzen.tekst: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

verzen.tekst: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verzen.html: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

verzen.tekst: The Jews therefore marvelled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

verzen.tekst: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
verzen.html: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

verzen.tekst: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
verzen.html: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

verzen.tekst: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verzen.html: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

verzen.tekst: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

verzen.tekst: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgement.”

verzen.tekst: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

verzen.tekst: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

verzen.tekst: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

verzen.tekst: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

verzen.tekst: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

verzen.tekst: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
